changed_from_shared_baseline: Cumulative-prefix recovery including earlier packaging; same service, soft reserve and physical safeguards.
Limit exception dates explicitly to reduce supplier prerequisites and solver branching; no service/rule downgrade.
Milk supply continuity on15/18 August required for high-demand worlds under peak60L; no zero-shortage universal policy imposed.
